title: ECS EC2 Service Configuration
description: Configuration schema for ECS EC2 Service component with Service Connect integration, autoscaling, and comprehensive observability

cluster.description: Name or ARN of the ECS cluster where the service will run. Can be a cluster name or full ARN.

image.description: Container image configuration for the ECS task

repository.description: Container image repository URI (e.g., ECR repository URL or Docker Hub image)

tag.description: Image tag to deploy. Defaults to 'latest' but specific version tags are recommended for production

taskCpu.description: CPU units allocated to the task. 256 units = 0.25 vCPU. Minimum 128, increases by framework (commercial: 256, fedramp-moderate: 512, fedramp-high: 1024+)

taskMemory.description: Memory in MiB allocated to the task. Must be compatible with taskCpu value per AWS ECS requirements

port.description: Container port to expose for the application. Must be a non-privileged port (1024-65535 recommended)

serviceConnect.description: ECS Service Connect configuration for service mesh integration

portMappingName.description: Name for the port mapping used by Service Connect for service discovery

dnsName.description: Optional custom DNS name for the service. Defaults to component name if not specified

namespace.description: Cloud Map namespace for service discovery. Uses cluster default namespace if not specified

environment.description: Environment variables to inject into the container as plaintext key-value pairs. For sensitive values, use 'secrets' instead

secrets.description: Secrets from AWS Secrets Manager to inject as environment variables. Values are secret ARNs

taskRoleArn.description: Optional ARN of an existing IAM role for the ECS task. If not provided, a new role will be created with minimal permissions

desiredCount.description: Desired number of task instances to run. Set to 0 to stop the service without deleting it

type.description: Type of placement constraint: 'memberOf' for attribute-based, 'distinctInstance' to spread across instances

expression.description: Cluster Query Language expression for 'memberOf' constraints (e.g., 'attribute:ecs.instance-type == t3.large')

placementConstraints.description: ECS placement constraints to control where tasks are placed on EC2 instances

placementStrategies.description: ECS placement strategies to optimize task distribution across EC2 instances

command.description: Health check command to run inside the container (e.g., ['CMD-SHELL', 'curl -f http://localhost:8080/health || exit 1'])

intervalSeconds.description: Time interval between health checks in seconds

timeoutSeconds.description: Time to wait for a health check response before considering it failed

retries.description: Number of consecutive failures required before marking container as unhealthy

autoScaling.description: Auto scaling configuration for the ECS service

minCapacity.description: Minimum number of tasks to maintain. Should be <= desiredCount

maxCapacity.description: Maximum number of tasks that can be scaled up to

targetCpuUtilization.description: Target CPU utilization percentage for scaling (e.g., 70 means scale when average CPU exceeds 70%)

targetMemoryUtilization.description: Target memory utilization percentage for scaling (e.g., 80 means scale when average memory exceeds 80%)

logging.description: CloudWatch Logs configuration for container logging

createLogGroup.description: Whether to create a new CloudWatch log group. Set to false to use an existing log group

logGroupName.description: Custom log group name. Defaults to '/ecs/{serviceName}/{componentName}' if not specified

streamPrefix.description: Prefix for CloudWatch log streams. Helps organize logs from multiple containers

retentionInDays.description: Log retention period in days. Framework defaults: commercial=30, fedramp-moderate=1827, fedramp-high=3653

removalPolicy.description: Policy for log group deletion: 'retain' keeps logs after stack deletion, 'destroy' deletes them

enabled.description: Whether to enable CloudWatch alarms for this service. Always true for FedRAMP deployments

alarms.description: Alarm configuration for CPU and memory metrics

enabled.description: Whether to create CPU utilization alarm

threshold.description: CPU utilization percentage threshold to trigger alarm. Framework defaults: commercial=80, fedramp-moderate=70, fedramp-high=60

evaluationPeriods.description: Number of consecutive periods threshold must be breached before alarming

enabled.description: Whether to create memory utilization alarm

threshold.description: Memory utilization percentage threshold to trigger alarm. Framework defaults: commercial=85, fedramp-moderate=75, fedramp-high=70

evaluationPeriods.description: Number of consecutive periods threshold must be breached before alarming

enableExecuteCommand.description: Enable AWS ECS Exec for interactive debugging. Enabled by default for FedRAMP deployments. Security consideration: only enable in non-production or when needed

tags.description: Additional custom tags to apply to all resources. Standard platform tags are applied automatically

observability.description: Observability configuration for distributed tracing, metrics, and monitoring. Supports both sidecar and centralized collector modes

enabled.description: Enable X-Ray tracing for the ECS service. When enabled, traces all requests and dependencies

mode.description: Collector mode: 'sidecar' adds X-Ray daemon container to task, 'centralized' uses account-level collector

adot.description: AWS Distro for OpenTelemetry (ADOT) collector configuration

enabled.description: Enable ADOT collector for OpenTelemetry traces, metrics, and logs

mode.description: Collector mode: 'sidecar' adds ADOT collector container to task, 'centralized' uses account-level collector

dashboard.description: CloudWatch Dashboard configuration for service monitoring

enabled.description: Create CloudWatch Dashboard with service metrics and logs. Recommended for all production services

widgets.description: Dashboard widgets to include. Default includes all standard widgets

egressPolicy.description: Egress traffic policy. 'allow-all' for development, 'vpc-only' for internal services, 'vpc-endpoints-only' for FedRAMP High

vpcEndpoints.description: VPC endpoint prefix list IDs for 'vpc-endpoints-only' policy (e.g., ['pl-12345678'] for CloudWatch Logs endpoint)
